title: Convert a Live Photo to SDR Without Choosing a Still Copy
description: To make a normal SDR Live Photo copy while retaining movement, choose an SDR export that preserves Live Photo motion rather than taking a screenshot.
direct: Choose a normal SDR Live Photo export when you need the motion. Open one saved result and check the movement and sound before you convert more.
figureAlt: A single coastal photo and a short filmstrip explain still and motion components.
figureCaption: AI-generated conceptual illustration, not an App screenshot, measured result or real export.
cards.choice.heading: Choose what you want to keep
cards.choice.body: A Live Photo includes a still image and a motion component. HDR appearance and motion are separate questions. Turning off HDR viewing changes playback on that device; it does not by itself create an SDR sharing copy. Keep the original available.
sections.explain.heading: Check the destination too
sections.explain.body: The receiving app may send only a still image even when the saved item is a Live Photo. Test the actual sharing route with one item before processing a collection. This is not a promise of Live Photo playback on every device or website.
sections.practice.heading: Distinguish the export choices
sections.practice.body: Its current listing supports keeping Live Photo motion for normal SDR export; HDR export creates a still photo. Normal-to-HDR is a creative brightness effect and cannot recover missing detail. The first three successful photo conversions are free, counting each batch item separately. Appearance still depends on the display, and the filmstrip illustration explains components rather than showing a tested export.
faqs.reader-question-1.heading: The saved photo moves in Photos, but the recipient sees a still. What happened?
faqs.reader-question-1.body: The sharing route may have delivered only the still component. Test another supported route and keep the moving original.
faqs.reader-question-2.heading: Will the HDR export keep the Live Photo motion?
faqs.reader-question-2.body: PhotoFix’s current HDR export creates a still photo. Use its normal SDR Live Photo option when keeping motion matters.

steps.step-1.text: In PhotoFix: HDR to Normal Photos, select the Live Photo and choose normal SDR conversion.
steps.step-2.text: Use the option to retain Live Photo motion and sound for that SDR export. Choose a still copy only when that is the intended deliverable.
steps.step-3.text: Open the saved result in Photos. Check its still appearance, then play the motion and listen to the sound before sharing.
